text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back from an outing with Symboli Kris S, as we leisurely walked along the riverbank—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heeey! Kris S~!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Teio. And Tsurumaru, too?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Kris S-san!
I was just doing some self-training with Teio-chan!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Still, running into Kris S during training—
what a crazy coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Hey, hey! Would you mind taking a look at us for a sec?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "...? I am... not a Trainer, however."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Prez told me, you know!
She said Kris S's training is totally thorough,
and that she's got amazing potential as a leader!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my very best!
Please, grant me a match!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
............
...I see—... In that case—I'll give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Excellent.
A wonderful—sense for it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Fufun! You bet!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...However—because you run purely on instinct—
at times—you push your legs—too hard."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —How you kick off the ground—the application of force. By adjusting—your center of gravity—it can be improved. For you—it will be easy—to master.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —You're pushing yourself a bit too hard.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*...
Sh-Should I pace myself
a bit more, maybe...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...More importantly—
Let the body—catch up to the heart.
A routine that elevates... physical robustness from the ground up.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: And—from dietary details—to lifestyle habits. Summarize key points—and compile—a memorandum.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even from a trainer's perspective, the instructions were spot-on and frighteningly thorough.
And just like that, the guidance went on and on—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, it was just like you said, Prez!
My running feels like it's completely changed
in just a short time! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! Doing this much for me...! Are you sure it's okay to do it for free!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I accepted the task, so I did my best.
—...That is all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Besides—our training—is not over yet.
—Follow me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
This is... my usual spot.
Order whatever you like.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! That's so generous!!
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? This menu...
"Aesthetics of Hard Water", "A Single Drop of Frosty Dew",
"Aqua Premium"—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, this is all just water?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. This is—
"Aqua and Liquid and Water."
A renowned shop—gathering famous waters—from all over.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aw, come on!
And here I thought I was gonna get treated to a meal!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...The grand finale... to training.
Work up a good sweat... replenish with good fluids.
In other words—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Time to hydrate.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. Now that you mention it... I drank all the ones I brought right away on the way here—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're even paying attention to that...?
Kris S is just as the Prez said!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It appears bringing me here wasn't a reward for training,
but an important part of the training itself.
choice_data_list: You're so thorough you'd put even a trainer to shame, huh.
You're so thorough you'd put even a trainer to shame, aren't you?
Aftercare is perfectly handled too, huh.
Aftercare is perfectly handled too, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It appears bringing me here wasn't a reward for training,
but an important part of the training itself.
choice_data_list: You're so thorough you'd put even a trainer to shame, huh.
You're so thorough you'd put even a trainer to shame, aren't you?
Aftercare is perfectly handled too, huh.
Aftercare is perfectly handled too, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...I said that, but still...
If anything, I really wanted to drink some Hachimi.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Anyway—give it a drink.
The water here... is delicious.

text_block_list.name: Teio & Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
!?!?!?
So... delicious!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once people tasted it, it was a massive hit.
In any case, it was a day where
Symboli Kris S's leadership truly shone.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you just wanted a drink of water,
wouldn't any park around here have worked...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Water is—surprisingly profound.
In fact—... depending on whether it suits you—
it even affects—performance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
If you know which water—suits you—
you can bring it with you—when traveling for races.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ! I see, you thought that far ahead and came here...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: K-Kris S-san... No! Drill Sergeaaant~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —It was a day that showcased Symboli Kris S's aptitude as a mentor.
